annual.reporting_basis: Purchased site electricity, before any PV credit. Heating and cooling are equipment electricity, not thermal loads. Cooling includes supplemental dehumidifier electricity. Hot water includes tank parasitics. Fans and pumps include the shared ERV and conditioning equipment.
annual.calculation: Monthly totals sum the EnergyPlus end-use electricity, including the dehumidifiers and the water heater's {power:20} standby draw, and match the building electricity meter.

review.severe_error_note: 39 non-convex casting surfaces under PolygonClipping shading (accepted 2026-11-03): an accuracy notice, not a failed run

systems: A water-source heat pump in each of the four zones, with provisional capacity allowances and matching air, water and fan flows. The ERV runs first. Performance curves and ground-loop water temperatures are generic.
Visitor Center and Core each have a generic {liquid_per_day:120} dehumidifier set to 60% RH, off while windows are open. Its electricity is in Cooling. Learning Labs and Restrooms have none.
One shared ERV, separate from heating and cooling, at 75% sensible and 50% latent effectiveness for all flows before frost control.
The ERV supplies Learning Labs, Visitor Center and Core. Air transfers through Core. Core and Restrooms exhaust through the ERV, with no separate restroom exhaust fan.
The ERV follows the scheduled ventilation and exhaust profiles. Heating and cooling stop in a zone while its windows may open.

Windows may open in an occupied zone when indoor air is {temperature:22} to {temperature:26} and outdoor air is {temperature:15} to {temperature:25} and at least {temperature_delta:1.5} cooler. Opening stops at an outdoor dew point of {temperature:13} and resumes below {temperature:12}.
Occupied: 70°F heating, 75°F cooling. Unoccupied: 68°F and 80°F. Each zone's warm-up period is in its Program page schedules.
Electric resistance tank: {temperature:10:0} mains, {temperature:60:0} storage, fixtures at {temperature:35:0} in Restrooms and {temperature:49:0} in Core. Tank size and piping are provisional.

Kiva two-dimensional ground model under all four slabs: 294 ft exposed perimeter, 2 in XPS interior vertical insulation down to the footing top at 3 ft 6 in, default soil. Foundation inputs are provisional. Typical-year White Plains weather.

controls.severe_error_note: 39 non-convex casting surfaces under PolygonClipping shading (accepted 2026-11-03): an accuracy notice, not a failed run

design_days.basis: Room loads are unfactored sensible thermal loads. Individual zone peaks are noncoincident. Detailed coil output includes ventilation and latent effects. Rated equipment inputs are provisional allowances.
sizing_notes: ERV heat recovery is a provisional 75% sensible and 50% latent, with frost control at a {temperature:0} minimum exhaust temperature. Frost control lowers the winter supply temperature, and the coil heating above includes it. The selected ERV sets the actual winter coil load.
Infiltration is a constant design rate until the airtightness basis is set. Its share of the room loads is in the component table.
On the summer design day the Core kettle and dishwasher run at full draw at the 14:15 building room-load peak.
Design days use a constant {temperature:18} slab ground, which credits the slab with some summer cooling. The annual run models the ground with Kiva.
Heat-pump performance curves and entering-water temperatures are generic, and the ground loop is a simple temperature relation standing in for a borefield. MEP and manufacturer data replace both.
Design days use the regular program; the four 100-person evening events in the annual run are not included.
These results do not size the borefield or select equipment.
